# Trust Your Sign

> A free astrology site: pick your zodiac sign, fly through its sky in 3D, and unlock a natal chart of your sun, moon and rising sign (the Big Three), computed from real astronomy. Also a free daily reading for every sign.

Trust Your Sign uses the tropical zodiac (the familiar one) and works out positions with a real astronomy library, not a lookup table. A birth date alone gives the sun sign. Adding a birth time and place unlocks the moon and rising signs; the site does not guess them without that. Readings are cultural and for entertainment, not medical, legal, financial or psychological advice. It is a small independent project by Devin Norris, in closed beta, free to use. Saving charts needs an account (16 and up); exploring and the daily readings do not.

## Pages

- [Home: the natal fly-through](https://trustyoursign.com/): pick a sign, fly its sky, and unlock a chart. Runs in the browser with 3D graphics.
- [Today's sky](https://trustyoursign.com/today): a daily reading for each sign from where the Moon is today, its phase, and how it lands on that sign. New every day at local midnight.
- [How this works](https://trustyoursign.com/how-this-works): how a chart is computed and what the Big Three are.
- [About](https://trustyoursign.com/about): what the site is, who made it, and what is still unfinished.
- [FAQ](https://trustyoursign.com/faq): entertainment or advice, data, deleting it, the beta, and why time and place matter.
- [Contact](https://trustyoursign.com/contact): how to reach the site about privacy, bugs and feedback.
- [Privacy Policy](https://trustyoursign.com/privacy): what is collected and why. No selling personal data, no advertising cookies, no training public models on charts.
- [Terms of Use](https://trustyoursign.com/terms): the rules for using the site.

## Today's reading for each sign

Each link opens that sign's reading for the visitor's local date. The reading is drawn in the browser, so it needs a page that runs JavaScript.
